titleEn: Neijuan (内卷) / Involution: The Academic Word Behind China's Rat Race
summaryEn: Neijuan, from the academic term 'involution', describes ever-harder competition with no real payoff — overtime theater, tiger parenting, degree inflation.
emotionEquivalent: 过度竞争 / 无效内耗

symbolLayer.explanation: 借自人类学术语 involution（内卷化）：系统内部不断精细化却不产生实质增长
symbolLayer.explanationEn: Borrowed from the academic term 'involution': a system that keeps refining itself internally without real growth.

origin: 2020年清华学生边骑车边用电脑的照片引发热议，学术词'内卷'破圈成大众语
originEn: A 2020 photo of a Tsinghua student riding a bike while using a laptop went viral, pushing the academic word 'neijuan' into everyday speech.
usage: 形容过度竞争导致的无效内耗：加班竞赛、鸡娃、学历军备竞赛
usageEn: Describes pointless over-competition: overtime races, tiger parenting, credential arms races.
commonMisreading: 常被误用为'竞争激烈'的同义词，实际核心含义是'投入增加但回报不变的恶性内耗'，强调无意义感
commonMisreadingEn: Often misused as a synonym for 'fierce competition'; the core meaning is 'vicious internal attrition where input rises but returns don't', emphasizing meaninglessness.

memeLineage.event: 清华'自行车电脑哥'照片走红，'内卷'破圈
memeLineage.eventEn: Tsinghua 'bike + laptop' photo goes viral; 'neijuan' breaks out of academia

memeLineage.event: 职场/教育场景大规模套用，成为年度热词
memeLineage.eventEn: Mass application in workplace and education scenarios; word of the year

memeLineage.event: 衍生'卷王''开卷''卷不动了'等动词化变体
memeLineage.eventEn: 'juan wang', 'kai juan', 'juan bu dong le' — verbal variants emerge

memeLineage.event: 'involution' 进入英语媒体报道，学界重新讨论该概念
memeLineage.eventEn: 'Involution' enters English media coverage, reigniting academic discussion

memeLineage.event: 英语世界用 'neijuan' 直接借词讨论东亚竞争文化
memeLineage.eventEn: The English-speaking world borrows 'neijuan' to discuss East Asian competition
